bullets.text: Spearheaded development of a new IDE extension version pinning system using Fleet GitOps with a Rails backend and MySQL database as a source of truth, preventing supply-chain attacks on employee machines company-wide.
Drove development of fine-grained, resource-scoped, autonomous agent-enabled MCP tools for first-party Shopify services with 5000+ users.
Collaborated with key stakeholders of first-party services to coordinate authentication, attribution, and least-privilege access for MCP tools.
Worked as a full-stack Android developer on the Infotainment Media App, completing 3 major features, fixing 20+ bugs, and integrating 30+ 3rd-party APKs.
Coached junior players using a game-based, long-term approach.
Co-founded CanDo Tennis, a freelance tennis coaching platform.
